title: wx.json
description: Manifest for a wx package. Every wx compilation is rooted at a directory containing one of these.

type.description: Only the package providing the language primitives, operator traits and intrinsics sets "type": "core". Ordinary packages omit this field. Every package can be imported or compiled to WebAssembly, with or without exports.

entry.description: Path to the entry source file, relative to this manifest's own directory. Never guessed from a conventional filename.

dependencies.description: Other local packages this package depends on, keyed by arbitrary strings selected by package declarations (for example, package "my-library" as math;). Only the source alias must be a valid identifier.

type.description: The dependency's source kind. Only "local" exists today.

path.description: Path to the dependency package's directory, relative to this manifest's own directory.

format.description: Formatter configuration for `wx format`. Every field is optional and falls back to the formatter's default when omitted.

max_line_width.description: Maximum line width the formatter will try to fit code within.

indent_width.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

lint.description: Lint levels for `wx check`, `wx build` and the language server, keyed by lint name. A lint that is not named keeps its default level. An unknown lint name or level makes the section invalid.

unused_variable.description: L3000: a local or parameter that is never read. Assigning is not a read; drop a value on purpose with `_ = x;`.

unnecessary_mutability.description: L3001: `mut` on a local that is never assigned.

unused_label.description: L3002: a loop or block label that no `break` or `continue` names.

lintLevel.description: What the lint reports as: nothing, a warning, or an error that fails the build.
